{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
# First, check if any revenue values contain commas
print('Checking for commas in revenue:')
print(data['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).sum())

# Strip commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Now filter out QA orders: revenue == 999999.99
qa_mask = data['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print(f'Number of QA orders found: {qa_mask.sum()}')

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders
filtered_data = data[~qa_mask & (data['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check the final population size
print(f'Final number of orders in analysis: {len(filtered_data)}')

# Compute conversion rate by customer_segment
conversion_rate_by_segment = filtered_data.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean() * 100
print('\nConversion rate by segment (in percent):')
print(conversion_rate_by_segment)

# Find the segment with highest conversion rate
best_segment = conversion_rate_by_segment.idxmax()
print(f'\nHighest conversion rate segment: {best_segment}')"}
